page: Amazon Web Services m8gb.12xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processors. It features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs running at 2.8 GHz with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The memory configuration consists of 192.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no local storage or GPU hardware, but delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps.

Benchmark results show strong multi-core capabilities, with Geekbench multi-core and software compilation tests reaching top-tier status. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with uncached large-block read and write speeds categorized in the top tier. Database operations and static web serving throughput also rank in the top tier. However, single-core performance in stress-ng and text processing tasks remains average.

A notable tradeoff is observed in LLM inference; while text generation for medium and large models is strong, text generation for small models is poor. The instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads, database operations, static web serving, and software compilation. Its ARM64 architecture offers resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for scale-out general-purpose applications compared to traditional x86 architectures.
